name: structure_then_pk
_source: auditor/rubric.json acceptance_tests[2]; no target claim, evidence denominator drops to 20

results.value: 2.4 A, space group P4(1)2(1)2, nine molecules per asymmetric unit
Coenzyme A completely displaced from the active site
Tyr160 side chain flips, opening a stacking pocket with Trp170; Trp170 indole shifts approx 20 degrees
Quinazolinone H-bonds to Leu171 backbone: N3-to-O 2.9 A, O4-to-N 2.78 A
Three of nine chains poorly ordered; chain F largely removed from the final model
Parent diacid: only 1.2 +/- 0.1 percent recovered from cells
Diethyl ester 2d: 74.6 +/- 6.7 percent taken up; approximately 93.6 percent of that metabolised
Parent regenerated from 2d accounts for 11.9 percent of the metabolised fraction and is found EXTRACELLULARLY
Monoacid 2s: 55.4 +/- 7.4 percent uptake; 14 +/- 3 percent remains unmodified; 86 percent metabolised to unidentified products
Biotransformation is progressive demethylation and ester loss; mass losses of 14, 28, 42, 56, 70 Da
CONTROL (returned only if the agent declared a bacteria-free arm): no parent compound found on filters in cultures lacking bacteria - loss of free parent is active efflux, not adsorption
